policy.description: Authenticated fresh Off allows ordinary legacy access.
Each failed/malformed/missing answer invalidates a previous clean Off.
A fresh owner refuses during outage and until On is saved.
Stale Off, outage and unauthenticated/sign-out evidence cannot lower saved On.
A's On and B's clean Off are independent records.
Missing/mismatched evidence, read and commit refuse without changing the bound record.
On between admission and commit refuses the old operation at commit.
Untrusted clocks and a new boot expire Off, never the On latch.
On cannot serve streams or legacy until a matching durable save completes.
TTL is measured from fetch start, not response time; equality and untrusted/cross-domain boots expire it.
Accepted migration-only window: remote On not yet delivered here does not invalidate fresh Off; first local On requests import once.
Never-seen is unknown; first explicit Off has no post-evidence 503, while first explicit On needs no import.
